text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Reference Statement Reference statement signed be a referee living in China or abroad. 7.Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English.
